hero.desc2: At Intrinsic Value, alpha is a natural result of a robust, data-driven strategy. Capital protection, strict risk management, and process govern every stock recommendation. We are a SEBI-registered equity research analyst service dedicated to sustainable wealth creation.

cards.title: Numbers don’t lie
cards.desc:
Our Research is based on Numbers not narratives, while there is nothing wrong with
                                    Growth stories, a lot of over valued narratives end up very badly when the Tide is
                                    over. If you have numbers you don’t need a story, if you don’t have numbers, story
                                    can’t help you. Remember Cons are the best story tellers.

Having worked in Engineering companies , Founders have an unparallel advantage over

cards.title: Skin in the Game

We practice what we preach and we preach what we practice. We are investors first,
                                    advisors after.

cards.title: No loss is profit
cards.desc:
Our concept of Buying at Minimum intrinsic value gives us Huge margin of safety
                                    against any unforeseen events or future unpredictability. We are rigid on not having
                                    loss, Profit is just the natural outcome.

cards.title: <s>Biases</s>
cards.desc:
Every strategy has opportunities as well as Traps. A defined Process, check lists and
                                    due diligence help us make unbiased decisions.

cards.title: Buying Peace in Chaos
cards.desc:
When the whole narrative is creating chaos against your investment decision, buying
                                    at such level is difficult but that is the most peaceful thing to do.

cards.title: Patience

Patience is not Gyan, Patience is the strategy. Long term attitude puts you in Diff

items.question: What is the investing approach.
items.answer: As a value investors, we look for the opportunities when great businesses go through rough phase. so whenever businesses goes through such period we buy stakes in them at their min intrinsic Value and when they do better and market understands their worth, we sell them at higher valuations, near their Maximum Intrinsic Value. (Refer BLOG LINK to understand the concept of Minimum/Maximum Intrinsic Value)

about_profile.name: Nikhil Gangil
paragraphs: Nikhil Gangil is the Founder of Intrinsic Value Equity Advisors and a long-term practitioner of value investing, with over 13 years of experience in Indian equity markets.

He holds an M.Tech from IIT Madras and has previously worked with reputed oil & gas and EPC organizations such as L&T and Worley. This background has given him hands-on exposure to infrastructure, construction, steel, oil & gas, and marine-linked businesses, particularly cyclical industries.
This experience enables him to understand how business cycles evolve and how long-term value is created across different economic phases.

Nikhil's investing philosophy is built on the belief that value and growth are not opposites, but complements. As he often emphasizes, "A value investor should not underestimate growth, and a growth investor should not underestimate value."

His core strength lies in identifying well-run businesses with sustainable growth potential, available at reasonable valuations, while maintaining a strong focus on risk management and capital protection.
Nikhil believes that if downside risks are controlled and permanent capital loss is avoided, long-term compounding and superior CAGR outcomes emerge naturally over time.
His approach to investing can be summarized in a simple philosophy:
about_profile.quote: Buying peace in chaos is value investing.
